name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct
purpose: Qwen states: agentic coding and foundational coding tasks, repository-scale understanding, tool calling and browser use among open models.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE read: Apache License 2.0 full text (patent grant, NOTICE and modification-notice duties on redistribution).

architecture.why_this_design: Not stated on the card; the record keeps the layout only (MoE, 30B total, 3B active). Check: the Qwen3-Coder technical report.

variants.format: GGUF, Q4_K_M 18.6 GB, UD-Q4_K_XL 17.7 GB, UD-IQ3_XXS 12.8 GB, Q8_0 32.5 GB

pc-12gb.notes: estimate from the file size (18.6 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM = 60 GB; about 52% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-16gb.notes: estimate from the file size (18.6 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM = 64 GB; about 73% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-24gb.notes: estimate from the file size (18.6 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM = 104 GB; about 100% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-32gb.notes: estimate from the file size (18.6 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 29.6 GB VRAM plus 114 GB RAM = 144 GB; about 100% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

mac-16-24gb.notes: estimate from the file size (18.6 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 12 GB)

mac-32gb.notes: estimate from the file size (18.6 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 22 GB)

mac-64gb+.notes: estimate from the file size (18.6 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 52 GB)

engine_support.notes: very widely supported; plain attention MoE, not a Tona backend

strengths: Widely supported, 1.96 million downloads, FIM tokens defined in its tokenizer (research/52), can also serve inline completion
weaknesses: Eighteen months older than the newest hybrids; no numbers on the card
soft.behavior: Sampling T 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, repetition_penalty 1.05; no think blocks.
soft.maturity: Qwen; a de facto standard local coder since mid-2025.

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0 text verified and a FIM-capable coder that runs on 12 to 16 GB classes (UD-Q4_K_XL 17.7 GB), so it keeps a purpose as the editor-autocomplete fallback; behind the 2026 MoE coders on agent benchmarks.
blockers: Tona engine support: none today (not a quality judgement)

sources.note: page text read through a summarizer (WebFetch)

open_questions: Current head-to-head numbers against Ornith-1.5 under one harness

Per-language quality and independent coding evidence: the Aider polyglot board is stale (mirrors: last update 2025-11-20, no entry for any model of this database), LiveCodeBench and swebench.com publish no per-language numbers for it that we could retrieve.
